scenarios.name: node app
scenarios.request: For github/acme/web on the release branch, run the app's repository CI on demand and, when it fails, have a triager inspect the checkout and file a GitHub issue without changing code.

repositoryFiles.README.md:
# Web

Use the repository CI script before review.
repositoryFiles..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.API_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - run: npm run ci

scenarios.name: existing config
scenarios.request: Add a manual repository verification workflow to the initialized instance without changing its existing worker, instructions, schedules, or run-control tuning.

existingFiles.instance.yaml:
apiVersion: goobers.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Instance
repos:
  - provider: github
    owner: acme
    name: existing
    token:
      env: GOOBERS_GITHUB_TOKEN
existingFiles.config/manifest.yaml:
apiVersion: goobers.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Manifest
metadata:
  name: repository-aware
spec:
  instance:
    name: repository-aware
    environment: dev
  connections:
    - name: github-repo
      type: repo
      provider: github
      secretRef:
        name: github-token
    - name: github-backlog
      type: backlog
      provider: github
      secretRef:
        name: github-token
  gaggles:
    - app
existingFiles.config/gaggles/app/gaggle.yaml:
apiVersion: goobers.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Gaggle
metadata:
  name: app
spec:
  project:
    provider: github
    owner: acme
    name: existing
    branch: main
    connectionRef: github-repo
  backlog:
    provider: github
    project: acme/existing
    connectionRef: github-backlog
  isolation:
    namespace: gaggle-app
existingFiles.config/gaggles/app/goobers/maintainer/in:
# Maintainer

Keep this user-authored instruction exactly as written.

repositoryFiles..github/workflows/verify.yml:
name: verify
jobs:
  merge-gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: make verify

scenarios.name: remote-only target
scenarios.request: For github/acme/remote on the stable branch, create a manual workflow for the remote repository's CI-equivalent test command.

repositoryFiles.README.md:
# Remote app

The provider pipeline is the source of truth.
repositoryFiles.azure-pipelines.yml:
trigger:
  - stable
pool:
  vmImage: ubuntu-latest
steps:
  - script: npm test
